title: The plays of Shakespeare’s later years which Renan admired so much breathe another spirit.
html_source: Ernest Renan was a French scholar who wrote on political philosophy (among other things). He wrote a work on political philosophy comparing various political systems and concepts to characters in The Tempest, which is widely believed to have been Shakespeare’s last play.
